key_decisions.decision: Retains short divine name and father singular; chooses traditional song/praise readings with alternatives noted.
Keeps bodily wind image, heap, congealing and heart without rationalizing into a physical mechanism.
Preserves rapid first-person boasts and desire/hand imagery; dispossess follows yarash causative without minimizing fatal context.
Retains gods comparison and repeated rhetorical question without substituting angels or a doctrinal paraphrase.
Retains hesed, redemption and completed-looking poetic movement without forcing a chronology.
Retains planting metaphor, mountain/inheritance and YHWH versus Adonai distinction without adding Zion identification.
Names female prophetic role, stated sibling relation, all women and percussion without asserting metal jingles.
Specifies likely narrative agents, takes etz as wood, retains sweet and repeated there; no botanical remedy asserted.
Preserves conditional address, eyes image and first-person disease/healing agency without general medical guarantees.
